mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS changes remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increased by >0.2pp in 3 months, or Rank IC for UNRATE changes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the prior 3 months indicates robust supply-side economic activity, which supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC for INDPRO changes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in consumer demand (RSAFS) and industrial output (INDPRO) signal synchronized demand-supply conditions that drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of RSAFS and INDPRO does not predict SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or the signal fails when RSAFS and INDPRO move in opposite directions.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3%), a sustained increase in consumer demand (RSAFS) relative to industrial output (INDPRO) drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 3% periods, RSAFS and INDPRO changes do not correlate with positive SPX 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in inflation exceeding 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals monetary tightening pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increased by >0.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL changes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates strong labor market conditions that drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not predict SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or the signal fails when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, INDPRO increases do not produce positive SPX 60-day returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC for INDPRO changes is below 0.03.
